title.en: Lotus Pharmaceutical (1795) Files Regulatory Notice for Bulgaria Subsidiary Lotus Pharma Bulgaria EOOD
title.zh-TW: 美時（Lotus，1795）代子公司 Lotus Pharma Bulgaria EOOD 公告：資金貸與背書保證準則事項

summary.en: Taiwan-listed Lotus Pharmaceutical (1795) has filed a regulatory notice on behalf of its subsidiary Lotus Pharma Bulgaria EOOD under the rules governing fund loans and endorsement guarantees by public companies. Spokesman Shen Ye, a vice president, made the filing on October 16; four similar notices for Alvogen subsidiaries were filed the same day.
summary.zh-TW: 上市公司美時（1795）代子公司 Lotus Pharma Bulgaria EOOD，依公開發行公司資金貸與及背書保證處理準則辦理公告。發言人沈燁（副總經理）於10月16日發布；同日另有四則針對 Alvogen 旗下子公司的類似公告。

body.en:
Taiwan-listed Lotus Pharmaceutical (ticker 1795) has filed a routine regulatory notice — this time on behalf of its Bulgarian subsidiary, Lotus Pharma Bulgaria EOOD.
What happened
Lotus Pharmaceutical filed the notice under Article 22, Paragraph 1, Item 2 of Taiwan's Regulations Governing Loaning of Funds and Making of Endorsements/Guarantees by Public Companies, on behalf of Lotus Pharma Bulgaria EOOD. The filing is numbered 1, dated October 16 at 15:05, with spokesman Shen Ye, a vice president, as the declarant. The same day brought four more identically formatted Lotus notices covering Alvogen Pharma US Inc., Alvogen Inc. and Alvogen Group Inc. (with Alvogen Pharma US Inc. appearing twice) — a batch of simultaneous compliance filings across the group's subsidiaries.
Why it matters
For investors, the point of such notices is not the amounts but the compliance itself: every fund loan and endorsement guarantee by a public company must be disclosed by law, and a missing filing is a violation. Five identical notices in a single day suggests the group is systematically tidying up its subsidiaries' fund-flow disclosures — an unusually active compliance push.
Sources agree / disagree
All five notices were carried only by GeneOnline, with identical formatting and wording and no contradictions. Trust label: 僅1源 — GeneOnline only, no cross-check; the Market Observation Post System filing is the authoritative text.
Still uncertain
The notice discloses only the spokesman, timestamp and legal basis — the actual amounts, counterparties and terms of the loans or guarantees are absent from the summary; consult the Market Observation Post System filing before quoting specifics.
body.zh-TW:
美時（股票代號1795）代子公司發布例行法令公告：這次的主角是保加利亞的 Lotus Pharma Bulgaria EOOD。
發生了什麼事
美時依「公開發行公司資金貸與及背書保證處理準則」第二十二條第一項第二款規定，代子公司 Lotus Pharma Bulgaria EOOD 辦理公告。公告序號為1，發言日期為10月16日15時05分，發言人是副總經理沈燁。同日，基因線上還轉載了四則格式相同的美時公告，代子公司分別為 Alvogen Pharma US Inc.、Alvogen Inc.、Alvogen Group Inc.（其中 Alvogen Pharma US Inc. 出現兩次），顯示這是一批子公司同步辦理的法令遵循事項。
為什麼重要
對投資人來說，這類公告的重點不在金額本身，而在「有沒有照規矩來」：公開發行公司的資金貸與與背書保證，每一筆都要依法公告，缺了就是違規。一天之內連發五則同類公告，代表集團正在系統性地整理子公司的資金往來揭露，法遵動作相當積極。
來源異同
五則公告都只有基因線上轉載，格式、用語完全一致，沒有互相矛盾之處。信任標籤：僅1源——只有基因線上轉載的公告訊息，無其他媒體對照；實質內容以公開資訊觀測站原文為準。
仍不確定
公告只揭露了發言人、時戳與法條依據，資金貸與或背書保證的實際金額、對象與條件都不在摘要中；引用細節前請查閱公開資訊觀測站原文。

title.en: Fire at Alberta Military Base Leaves Dead and Injured; Wainwright ‘Completely Overwhelmed’
title.zh-TW: 加拿大亞伯達省軍事基地大火傳死傷：溫賴特醫院「完全不堪負荷」

summary.en: People have been killed and injured after a ‘serious incident’ caused a large fire at one of Canada's busiest military training bases in Alberta, officials said Saturday. Defence Minister David McGuinty confirmed fatalities but gave no figures or cause, while a local doctor said Wainwright was ‘completely overwhelmed’ and patients were being sent to Edmonton hospitals.
summary.zh-TW: 官員上週六表示，加拿大最繁忙的軍事訓練基地之一在亞伯達省發生「嚴重事件」引發大火，造成死傷。國防部長麥堅蒂（David McGuinty）證實有死傷，但未公布數字與起火原因；當地醫師表示溫賴特已「完全不堪負荷」，傷患正送往愛德蒙頓的醫院。

body.en:
A large fire tore through a military base in Alberta, Canada, on Saturday, leaving dead and injured. A local doctor's verdict: Wainwright is ‘completely overwhelmed.’
What happened
Officials said Saturday that a ‘serious incident’ at one of Canada's busiest military training bases in Alberta caused a large fire, killing and injuring people. Defence Minister David McGuinty confirmed there were fatalities and injuries but provided no figures and no cause of the fire, describing the situation on the ground as ‘very, very active and delicate.’ A local doctor said Wainwright was ‘completely overwhelmed’ by the number of injuries, with patients being taken to hospitals in Edmonton. The BBC, The Guardian, Bloomberg and Al Jazeera all reported the same event with matching headlines: major fire, deaths and injuries, officially confirmed.
Why it matters
Safety incidents at military training bases are sensitive because they implicate both defense readiness and public trust: this is one of the country's busiest bases, and any major accident can ripple through training schedules and deployment capacity. With information scarce, the defence minister confirming casualties in person signals a situation too serious to downplay.
Sources agree / disagree
All four international outlets agree on the core facts — the Alberta base fire, deaths and injuries, the minister's confirmation without figures or cause — with no factual conflicts. Trust label: N源一致 — four outlets agree on the fire and the official account.
Still uncertain
Casualty numbers, the fire's cause and what the ‘serious incident’ actually was are all unknown; the minister's ‘delicate’ wording suggests the investigation is in a sensitive phase. Verify details in the full reporting before quoting specifics.
body.zh-TW:
加拿大亞伯達省一處軍事基地上週六發生大火，傳出死傷。當地醫師形容，溫賴特已經「完全不堪負荷」。
發生了什麼事
官員上週六表示，加拿大最繁忙的軍事訓練基地之一發生「嚴重事件」，引發的大火造成人員死傷。國防部長大衛·麥堅蒂（David McGuinty）證實有死亡與受傷，但沒有公布數字，也沒有說明起火原因，僅形容當地情況「非常、非常緊急且微妙」。當地醫師表示，溫賴特因傷患人數「完全不知所措」，病患正被送往愛德蒙頓的醫院。BBC、衛報、彭博與半島電視台四家都報導了同一事件，標題一致指向：大火、死傷、官方證實。
為什麼重要
軍事訓練基地的工安事件之所以敏感，在於它同時牽涉國防戰力與公共信任：基地是「最繁忙」等級，任何重大意外都可能影響訓練排程與部署能量。而在資訊有限的情況下，部長親自出面證實死傷，代表事態已嚴重到無法低調處理。
來源異同
四家國際媒體對核心事實一致：亞伯達省軍事基地大火、有死傷、部長證實但無數字與原因，沒有事實衝突。信任標籤：N源一致——四家對火災與官方說法的報導一致。
仍不確定
死傷人數、起火原因、「嚴重事件」的具體內容全部未知；部長用「微妙」形容，暗示調查仍在敏感階段。引用細節前請查閱完整報導。

summary.en: Woot has launched a huge sale on vacuums from Dyson, Roborock, Roomba, Ecovacs, Shark and Samsung, with prices starting at $20. CNET also flags a $155 Samsung Buds 4 Pro deal, while Slickdeals notes a buy-5-get-40%-off health and personal care promo with free shipping for Prime members.

body.en:
Time for a new vacuum? Woot says the time is now: big-name vacuums from Dyson, Roborock and more, starting at $20.
What happened
Woot has launched a huge vacuum sale spanning Dyson, Roborock, Roomba, Ecovacs, Shark, Samsung and more — stick, upright and robot vacs — with prices starting at $20. CNET's deals desk separately flags the Samsung Buds 4 Pro with ANC 2.0 and Bluetooth 6.1 for just $155, a $95 saving. Slickdeals' frontpage highlights a different Woot promo running in parallel: buy 5+ health and personal care items for 40% off (50% off for new customers), with free shipping for Prime members who log in with their Amazon account and select a shipping address — otherwise $6 per order.
Why it matters
This pre-holiday-season push is the classic double play: clearance pricing to move inventory, Prime free shipping to lock shoppers into the Amazon ecosystem. For consumers, $20 brand-name vacuums and a $155 flagship earbud sit squarely in the ‘regret-not-buying, don't-regret-buying’ price zone.
Sources agree / disagree
Slickdeals covers the health-and-personal-care promo, CNET the vacuum and earbud deals — different Woot sales running in parallel, with no numeric conflicts (buy-5-get-40%-off vs. from-$20 are separate offers). Trust label: 2源促銷 — both are deal-intel sources; actual prices per Woot's checkout page.
Still uncertain
End dates and per-item discount depths are absent from the snippets; check Woot's official pages before buying.
body.zh-TW:
該換吸塵器了嗎？Woot 說現在就是時候：戴森、石頭科技等大牌吸塵器 20 美元起跳。
發生了什麼事
Woot 推出了吸塵器大促銷，涵蓋戴森（Dyson）、石頭科技（Roborock）、Roomba、Ecovacs、Shark、三星等知名品牌，棒式、直立式、掃地機器人全包，價格從 20 美元起。CNET 的折扣線另點名：具備 ANC 2.0 與藍牙 6.1 的三星 Buds 4 Pro 耳機只要 155 美元，直接便宜 95 美元。Slickdeals 的前台情報則是另一檔：健康與個人護理用品買5件打6折、新客打5折，Prime 會員免運（需用亞馬遜帳號登入並選好地址），非會員每單運費 6 美元。
為什麼重要
年底購物季前的這波促銷，是典型的清庫存＋衝會員雙重操作：用低價吸塵器帶流量，用 Prime 免運把人綁進亞馬遜生態系。對消費者來說，20 美元起的品牌吸塵器和 155 美元的旗艦耳機，都是「不買會後悔、買了不心痛」的價格帶。
來源異同
Slickdeals 聚焦站內健康護理促銷，CNET 聚焦吸塵器與耳機折扣，兩家談的是 Woot 同期的不同檔期，數字上沒有衝突（買5件打6折 vs 20美元起是不同優惠）。信任標籤：2源促銷——兩家都是折扣情報來源，實際價格以 Woot 結帳頁為準。
仍不確定
促銷的結束時間、各品項的實際折扣幅度都不在摘要中；下單前請以 Woot 官方頁面為準。
